parameters.content:
# 🎯 Local Business Lead Machine
Finds local businesses with a weak online presence, scores them by opportunity, and drafts personalized outreach — end to end, on autopilot.

### How it works
1. Submit a business type + city through the built-in form.
2. Apify scrapes Google Maps and removes duplicate listings.
3. Every website is fetched and audited for online booking, live chat, mobile-friendliness and a contact form (Firecrawl re-checks any site that fails or returns no email).
4. A transparent 0–100 rule-based score sorts each lead into 🔥 Hot / 🟡 Warm / ❄️ Cold — no AI involved in scoring.
5. GPT-5-mini writes a subject line, email body and cold-call opener for Hot/Warm leads only.
6. Everything is saved to Google Sheets and a Slack summary is posted.
7. A weekday scheduler creates Gmail **drafts** (never auto-sent) for leads you mark "Approved".

### Setup steps
1. Add credentials: Apify (Header Auth), Firecrawl (Header Auth), Google Sheets, Slack, Gmail and an OpenAI chat model.
2. Create a Google Sheet with **Leads** and **Runs** tabs — column names are visible in the Google Sheets node schemas.
3. Set your Slack channel in every Slack node.
4. Test with Max Results = 20 first (saves Apify credits) before scaling up.
5. After any edit, toggle **Active** off/on so the schedule trigger runs the published version.

### Customization tips
Tune the weights in the Opportunity Score node, or edit the "Your Service" dropdown in the form to match what you sell.

## 1️⃣ Find Businesses
Apify scrapes Google Maps for the search + city.
Duplicate listings (same place or same website) are merged.

## 2️⃣ Audit Each Website
Fetches every site and detects booking tools, live chat, mobile-friendliness and contact forms.
Firecrawl re-checks any site that failed or returned no email.

## 3️⃣ Score & Filter
Rule-based 0–100 opportunity score.
60+ = 🔥 Hot · 35–59 = 🟡 Warm · <35 = ❄️ Cold (skips the AI pitch).

## 4️⃣ AI Writes the Pitch
Only Hot/Warm leads get a pitch (saves AI calls).
GPT-5-mini writes a subject line, email body and call opener, grounded only in the gaps actually found.

## 5️⃣ Save & Notify
Every lead (Hot/Warm/Cold) is saved to the Leads sheet.
Run totals are logged and a Slack summary is posted.

## 6️⃣ Approved Outreach — Weekdays 10 AM
Only leads you set to **Approved** are processed.
Creates a **Gmail draft** per lead — nothing is ever sent automatically.

## ⚠️ Error Alerts
Any node failure anywhere in the workflow posts a Slack alert.
